content: Podman is a deliberate Docker CLI drop-in: same run/ps/logs/exec/build command structure, so 'docker'->'podman' is an argv-prefix swap for exec -i and run. Two real divergences to handle: (1) --format json output shape -- docker emits line-delimited JSON objects, podman emits a JSON array; podman ps --format '{{json .Labels}}' returns a map where docker returns a string; inspect differs on timestamps, Args null vs [], tag vs sha256. A parser must accept both NDJSON and array shapes. (2) rootless mounts -- SELinux needs :z/:Z on -v, and UID/GID mapping needs --userns=keep-id (plus /etc/subuid,/etc/subgid range) or the container writes files the host user cannot read. Canonical recipe: podman run --rm -i --userns=keep-id -v "$PWD":/workspace:Z -w /workspace img cmd.
